sampling_design: Every third calendar day from 1 September through 31 October 2026; all completed GB AW handicaps with at least four final runners and one winner. No outcome-based race selection.
source_limitations: Historical first availability is not attested. Cards fetched after results may be corrected.
Conditions on final runner field; not an auditable pre-off non-runner simulation.
No prices, betting returns or prospective challenge credit.
